QuestInfo.name: [Riena Strait] Maybe I Shouldn't Have Gotten a Boat
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1510005##k in #b#m141000000##k will gladly lend you a boat, if you can bring back 3 #b#t4030022##k items from the ocean. Talk to #b#p1510006##k to get going.
QuestInfo.2: You proved your seaworthiness to #b#p1510005##k in #b#m141000000##k and now you have a boat!

0.0: Ya said you've never gone out on the water, right? Do ya even know your rudder from your bow? Let's find out.
0.1: While you're out there, bangin' my boat up, would ya mind bringin' in a bit o' the #bShip Wreckage#k ya find? I'm lookin' for #bgood lumber#k.
